items.label: la cuisse
items.scene: A dancer carries a plate of QUICHE ("KWEES") and pats her strong THIGH.

items.label: la barbe
items.scene: A BARBER ("BAHRB") with comb and scissors trims an old man's enormous BEARD, curls tumbling to the floor.

items.label: la moustache
items.scene: A MOOSE ("MOOS") with a huge curly MOUSTACHE twirls its ends in a hand mirror.

items.label: la mâchoire
items.scene: Mother crocodile, 'MA' ("mah"), opens her huge JAW wide under a garden SHOWER ("SHWAHR") to rinse her teeth.

items.label: l'haleine
items.scene: A little dragon's warm BREATH melts A LANE ("ah-LEHN") through the icicles on the frosted glass door.

items.label: la narine
items.scene: A curious horse flares one big NOSTRIL to sniff a ripe NECTARINE ("-ta-REEN") held up on a palm.

items.label: la pommette
items.scene: A cheerleader waves her red POM-pom ("poh") high, smiling with rosy CHEEKBONES at the friend she just MET ("MEHT").

items.label: le menton
items.scene: A strongMAN ("mahn") juts out his huge square CHIN as he balances a one-TON ("TOHN") iron ball on his forehead.

items.label: le poumon
items.scene: A PUMA ("poo-MOHN") fills its LUNGS with a huge breath and has blown up two pink balloons that bob above its head.
